definitions.explanation: Paying more than the amount actually owed, as with taxes, fees, or interest.

examples.japanese: {過払|かばら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
{過払|かばら}い⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返金|へんきん}して→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To get the overpaid amount refunded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{払|はら}い→払う：00535_harau⟧すぎた⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}そう→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{過払|かばら}い{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people filed claims to recover the interest they had overpaid.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過払|かばら}い{金|きん} (money overpaid, especially interest charged above the legal limit)
- {過払|かばら}い{金|きん}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧ (a claim for refund of overpaid interest)
- ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過払|かばら}い (overpayment of tax)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{過払|かばら}い{金|きん} is familiar from law-firm advertising on TV and trains. After a 2006 Supreme Court ruling, borrowers could reclaim interest that consumer lenders had charged above the ceiling set by the Interest Rate Restriction Act ({利息制限法|りそくせいげんほう}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未払|みばら}い→未払い：18029_mibarai⟧: unpaid, outstanding (the opposite problem)
